name: StackWC Custom Permalinks for WooCommerce
author: StackWC

sections.description:
Custom Permalinks for WooCommerce is a simple WordPress plugin that gives you control over your WooCommerce product and category permalinks. Create clean, SEO-friendly URLs that improve your site’s search engine rankings and user experience.

Features

  • Customize product permalink structure (product slug only, with category, or full path)
  • Remove product base (/product/) from URLs
  • Remove category base (/product-category/) from URLs
  • Add custom URL suffixes (.html, .htm, etc.)
  • Regenerate permalinks functionality
  • Clean, simple settings interface
  • Full WooCommerce compatibility
  • SEO-friendly URL structures

Why Use Custom Permalinks for WooCommerce?

  • SEO Benefits: Clean URLs improve search engine rankings
  • User Experience: Shorter, more memorable URLs
  • Flexibility: Customize permalink structure to match your needs
  • Professional: Remove unnecessary slugs for cleaner URLs
  • Compatible: Works with all WooCommerce themes and plugins

Installation

=

  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/stackwc-custom-permalinks-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Custom Permalinks to configure your settings
  4. Configure your desired permalink structure
  5. Click “Regenerate Permalinks” to apply changes

Frequently Asked Questions

Does the plugin work with all WooCommerce themes?

Yes, Custom Permalinks for WooCommerce is compatible with all WooCommerce themes and plugins.

Will changing permalinks affect my SEO?

Changing permalinks may temporarily affect SEO. It’s recommended to set up proper redirects and notify search engines of URL changes.

Can I customize individual product permalinks?

This version provides global permalink settings for all products.
